reviews.title: App won’t open
reviews.text: All the sudden the app will not open, only goes to logo screen and the crashes and closes. I’ve been using this app for…8 years now?

reviews.title: Terrible Update
reviews.text: This update pretty much got rid of so many of the reasons why planoly was great for scheduling. The inability to post without cropping in the planoly app or letting planoly post automatically for you is a PAIN and NOT user friendly. All I wanted was to be able to include 20 photos in a post on planoly but they couldn’t even even get that right. Also the inclusion of AI is terrible, STOP pushing it on your paying users and fix the actual issues.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Never been so saddened by an update in my life. This was one of my favorite apps and now it isn’t even worth downloading. I didn’t use it to post, I used it to plan my feed and they’ve made it so much more difficult to do that. Can’t use it unless you’re actively linked with an account (in my case, Instagram), but when I try to, it keeps sending me to Facebook, despite the fact that I don’t have a FB account. At this point, the app truly is useless for me and I’ll have to cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: Hate the update!!!
reviews.text: Go back. Stuff isn’t working and it’s super confusing now. Not user friendly

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for over 5 years. I’m a social media manager so I have 4 social media accounts on this app. They hadn’t made any updates for over 3 years, a lot of features were outdated. They just did a huge update and it lost all of my draft posts that I’ve put months of work into for all of my accounts. Even before this, anytime I had an issue with a glitch on their site or app, they take over 24 hours to get back to you, and never solve your issue. This has happened multiple times over the last few years. Terrible service, the reason I hadn’t switched services is because I had everything already uploaded into their system. I guess it will be easy to find another service now, since they deleted all my data and drafts in their horrible update. It’s also very expensive compared to other systems out there. Thanks for nothing Planoly!

reviews.title: New update not good
reviews.text: The new PLANOLY update is terrible. You can barely see the grid because of the huge “Draft” and “Posted” labels, and deleting a post now requires five additional clicks. The previous version was far more user-friendly. Please let me know if there is an option to switch back to the old layout.

reviews.title: Aesthetic over experience design
reviews.text: The newest update of this app has its benefits, but I find it more difficult to navigate than ever - with more clicks necessary along the way. Please return the ability to select posts and delete, coming from someone who often adds multiple photo options.

reviews.title: App changed, no longer usable for main function
reviews.text: They’ve replaced the published/unpublished icons with obstructive boxes with words and colours, so the ability to plan out a cohesive or aesthetic feed is gone. Not clear on the new function but it has completely moved away from its original use. Such a disappointing change

reviews.title: Honestly, terrible.
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years, always facing frustration with countless issues. The single benefit that made me keep it was the ability to visually plan multiple feeds within one app by using the drafts folders. It was extremely handy and made up for all of the other shortcomings of the app. I’ve just had to update to the new version to continue using the app and the new interface not only wipes this entire option, but has essentially thrown away all of the ongoing feeds that I’ve been meticulously building for years. I now have to work out how to download all the media I’ve uploaded and spend hours, if not days, re-organising it by memory in another platform. I’m really disappointed and to be frank, shocked, that they would implement these changes without warning their users of the implications to their existing work.

reviews.title: Will not connect to accounts
reviews.text: I download planoly every year and i run into the same issue every time: it will not connect to my facebook account. It just keeps saying “error try again later” Its basically unusable for me.

reviews.title: They delete comments and your data even if you’re a paying customer
reviews.text: I’ve been a paying customer for a long time and I looooved the app. I used it for everything. They IG feed planner and I put hours of my life into it. They deleted everything in one day. Hours of my work. No help from customer service and they delete hundreds of comment on their social media pages. I’m going to use Scroll and Planoly instead

reviews.title: Terribly Glitchy
reviews.text: Trying to link my account, hitting fix and nothing happening. Tried multiple times. No interest in an app that doesn’t work, I want to be able to set everything up the first time w it out having to contact support and wait days

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: It glitches everyday. The stats don’t work. I have to find workarounds to get basic things done (like adding to a carousel).

reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text:
This app allowed me to upload and plan all my posts for the next year, around 30… and deleted them all then disconnected my instagram and swapped it for a new one I had just made that was completely unrelated my my MAIN account I was planned posts for. 

I connect my instagram to 100s of sites and apps with no issues, but no with Planoly, you can plan on not only wasting your time but not being able to do a simple account link I could do 15 years ago. 

Yeah cool logo and rebrand… not.
